# Shot templates, type kinds, camera rigs and motion primitives

## Shot templates (compositing)

| Template | Implemented | Needs | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **FULL_BLEED** | yes | 1 asset | The footage fills the frame; the camera rig decides the move. |
| **CAMERA** | yes | 1 asset | A shot built around a visible camera move: always a compound move, never static. |
| **CROP_DETAIL** | yes | 1 asset, a detected subject | A tight crop of the subject fills the frame, then the camera works the detail. |
| **2_5D** | yes | 1 asset, a detected subject | Depth by splitting the picture: soft background + cut-out subject that moves more. |
| **PARALLAX** | yes | 1 asset, a detected subject | Three-layer lateral parallax across the shot. |
| **PIP** | yes | 1 asset, a second asset (optional) | Main shot with a framed inset of a second clip that slides in. |
| **SPLIT_SCREEN** | yes | 1 asset, a second asset (optional) | Two panels side by side, each cropped around its own subject. |
| **TEXT_SCENE** | yes | no asset, text | Type on a dark field (a blurred ghost of the footage if one is supplied). |
| **STAT_SCENE** | yes | no asset, a stat | One big number with a label over a dimmed backdrop. |
| **CALLOUT** | yes | 1 asset, a detected subject, callout text | Footage with a label and leader line pointing at the subject. |
| **HUD_SCENE** | yes | 1 asset | Footage under a thin HUD frame with technical readouts. |
| **MAP_SCENE** | **no (TODO)** | no asset | TODO: needs map data / a reliable geo asset pipeline; not implemented, never chosen automatically. |
| **FREEZE_FRAME** | yes | 1 asset, ≥ 0.9s | Plays briefly, then holds one frame (never longer than 0.7 s) with a punch-in, then carries on. |
| **IMPACT_SCENE** | yes | 1 asset, ≥ 0.6s | Build, slow-down, hit: velocity ramp into an impact with shake, flash and a slammed word. |
| **DARK_TITLE** | yes | no asset, text | Near-black field, slow title; a faint ghost of the footage breathes behind it. |
| **END_CARD** | yes | no asset, text | Closing card: title, line of support, long hold, fade to black. |

## Camera rigs

| Rig | Character | Amount (fraction of frame) | Max overscan | Moves |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **CAMERA_CINEMATIC** | Slow, weighty dolly and arc moves with long easing; occasional gentle handheld on intense shots. | 0.06–0.16 | 1.22 | push, pull, drift, orbit, follow, reveal, push+drift, handheld, held |
| **CAMERA_VELOCITY** | Punchy: fast ease-out-expo pushes, whips, slides, beat impacts and decaying shake. | 0.14–0.32 | 1.5 | punch-in, push-hard, pull-snap, slide, whip-in, whip-out, shake-hit, bounce, follow, pan |
| **CAMERA_DOCUMENTARY** | Observational: slow subject-aware Ken Burns, steady pans and tilts, nothing flashy. | 0.05–0.12 | 1.15 | follow, push, pan, tilt, drift, pull, held |
| **CAMERA_PRODUCT** | Clean and deliberate: smooth orbits and pushes to detail, subject-focused, no shake. | 0.06–0.14 | 1.2 | orbit, follow, push, reveal, push+drift, pull, pan |
| **CAMERA_ACTION** | Aggressive: constant handheld, hard pushes with overshoot, whips, big beat impacts. | 0.16–0.36 | 1.6 | handheld, push-hard, punch-in, whip-in, whip-out, shake-hit, slide, bounce, pull-snap |

## Motion primitives (composable into one keyframe track)

| Primitive | Holds its end pose | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| PUSH | yes | Dolly in (scale up), optionally about a focus point. |
| PULL | yes | Dolly out: starts tight, ends wide. |
| DRIFT | yes | Slow diagonal float along `dir` degrees. |
| PAN | yes | Horizontal camera pan. dir 0 = camera moves right (picture slides left). |
| TILT | yes | Vertical camera tilt. dir 0 = camera tilts down. |
| ORBIT | yes | Elliptical arc around the subject with a hint of roll. |
| WHIP | yes | Fast whip-pan. mode "in" arrives from off-axis and settles; "out" accelerates away. Wants motion blur. |
| SHAKE | no | Seeded handheld/impact shake. `decay` 0 = constant, 1 = dies out linearly, >1 = snappy. |
| BOUNCE | yes | Starts punched-in and settles with a damped spring. |
| IMPACT | no | Beat hit: instant punch-in with a kick along `dir`, decaying exponentially. |
| REVEAL | yes | Opens tight and settles fast - a "here it is" move. |
| FOLLOW | yes | Pushes in while sliding the subject toward the frame centre. |
| TRACK | yes | Keeps a moving subject (p.path = [{t,x,y}] in seconds/frame fractions) near the centre, smoothed. |
| PARALLAX | yes | One layer of a depth stack: translation scaled by `depth` (1 = foreground, <1 = further away). |
